AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
